affected_system: public participation, multilingual communication, consultation, and feedback closure
alternatives: protect minimum coverage before needs-based allocation of public participation and communication support resources
adapt allocations using observed demand, uptake, and capacity for public participation and communication support resources
pair affected-population and minimum-access allocation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Invitation, exposure, participation, contribution, response, decision, and trust remain distinct.
Participation records preserve consent, privacy, language, accessibility, and channel provenance.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain the current distribution rule for public participation and communication support resources.

constraints.description: The public participation and risk communication allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: public engagement director and risk communications lead
decision_question: How should outreach, interpreters, accessibility support, stipends, facilitation, and response capacity be assigned?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The public participation and risk communication allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.decision_object: public participation and communication support resources
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for public participation and communication support resources passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.primary_outcome: affected engagement needs without assigned usable support

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting public participation and communication support resources, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: affected engagement needs without assigned usable support
distributional gap in affected engagement needs without assigned usable support
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report allocated support as participation, representation, agreement, or influence.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for public participation and communication support resources passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate engagement, translation, and participation support
transportability_risks: Trust, language, civic institutions, digital access, deliberation norms, and risk salience differ.
Participants are not automatically representative of affected populations.
